purpose: Illustrative category artwork for a clearly labeled sample catalog; not photographs of actual inventory.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: illustrative category artwork for a clearly labeled sample ecommerce catalog.
Primary request: a premium silver laptop open at an elegant three-quarter angle on a very light gray seamless studio background.
Subject: one clean unbranded silver aluminum laptop, slim precise construction, dark screen showing only a minimal deep blue abstract wallpaper.
Style/medium: restrained photoreal studio product photography, highly realistic hardware and materials.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, full product visible, balanced centered composition with generous negative space.
Lighting/mood: soft controlled studio light, natural contact shadow, refined and quiet.
Constraints: no brand, no logo, no text, no watermark, no humans, no decorative elements, no accessories. No graphic gradients outside physical studio lighting. Keep the screen artwork minimal and understated.
